module: "Time Trials" sub-window of the race editor: track metadata (name, description, authors, difficulty Easy/Medium/Hard/Very Hard), classification flags (Reversible, Rolling Start, computed by path:classify()), presence of a preview image <name>.jpg next to the race file, and three prefab lists (prefabs, forwardPrefabs, reversePrefabs) to load with the track. Each change goes through editor.history. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/raceEditor/timeTrials')(raceEditor).
notes: Difficulty: stored as an integer; the list choice writes (i-1)*25+12 (12, 37, 62, 87); the display reverses it with floor(d/25)+1 clamped between 1 and 4.

Automatic prefab: <file name>.prefab, <name>_forward.prefab, <name>_reverse.prefab (loaded if they exist). Forward prefabs only load in the normal direction, reverse ones only in the reverse direction (code tooltips).

Bug: in C:existsIcon, "local levelPath" is redeclared inside the "if lvl" block, which shadows the outer variable; the inPathFolder parameter therefore has no effect and the tested path stays the race path folder.
In prefabData, the name of the third group displays "ReversePrefabs" with a leading space (typo).

C.desc: Time Trials window (windowDescription = 'Time Trials'). Instantiated with init(raceEditor); the module is stored in self.pathEditor.

init.desc: Stores the raceEditor module in self.pathEditor.

setPath.desc: Sets the race path being edited and reloads the window fields (calls selected()).

selected.desc: Reloads name, description, authors and prefab lists from the path, then looks for the preview image.

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left; does nothing.

findPreview.desc: Looks for <folder><file name>.jpg; if present, loads it as the preview texture, otherwise clears the preview.

draw.desc: Called every frame: draws the general information.

changeField.desc: If the new value differs from path[field], commits a history action that modifies this path field.

field.desc: Path field name (name, description, authors, difficulty, prefabs, forwardPrefabs, reversePrefabs).

add.desc: Detail added to the history action name.

drawGeneralInfo.desc: Draws the whole form: text fields, difficulty, classification, preview indicator (hover = image, click = refresh) and prefab lists.

displayClassification.desc: Displays a "name:" line with a check or cross icon depending on classification[field].

existsIcon.desc: Displays a check icon (file found) or error icon (not found) for a prefab, testing several paths (with/without .prefab, .prefab.json, .json, level or path folder). The tooltip lists the file found or the paths tried.

f.desc: File name, or explicit list of paths to test.

inPathFolder.desc: Supposed to search in the race path folder (no effect, see notes).

drawPrefabs.desc: Draws the prefab list of a field: read-only automatic entry, then for each prefab delete, input, file picker and existence icon, and an Add button.

default.desc: Name of the automatically loaded prefab.
